🎂 ADAM DRIVER TURNS 43 🎂
Adam Driver was born on November 19, 1983 — 43 years ago today — and his Kylo Ren stole The Force Awakens.
To mark his 43rd birthday, we're spotlighting a fan edit from the collection: Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens - IC Cut - Fan Edit.
The IC Cut of the sequel trilogy opener.
DM us for the link — THE WORLD'S LARGEST FAN EDIT COLLECTION.
